meta.nfp_source: BLS release rule (third Friday after the week containing the 12th) + known 2025-26 moves (bls.gov not reachable)
meta.method: per instrument and month: half-hour volume and high-low / the month median; activity = sqrt(vol x range)

summary: - **Forex currencies (62 pairs, median 21.8 years):** the strongest half-hours start at 08:00 (1.98x), 06:30 (1.81x), 01:00 (1.60x) Calgary. 06:30 (US data) 1.81x, 07:30 (NYSE open) 1.89x, 08:00 1.98x, London open 01:00 1.60x; quietest around 15:00 (rollover) 0.49x.
- **Each pair's own best half-hour:** 08:00 for 48 pairs, 08:30 for 8 pairs, 09:00 for 2 pairs, 01:00 for 2 pairs. 96.8% of pairs have reliable best times (both halves of the history agree).
- **Index / commodity CFDs (32):** peaks at 07:30 (2.37x), 01:00 (1.40x), 12:00 (1.05x) - the cash-market opens dominate.

- **Weekdays, forex currencies:** day activity Mon 0.91x / Tue 0.99x / Wed 1.02x / Thu 1.05x / Fri 1.02x - only 15% between the busiest and the quietest weekday. Best weekday reliable for 66.1% of instruments (mostly Thu 35, Fri 6).

- **NFP Fridays:** the 06:30 Calgary half-hour moves 2.32x as far as on other Fridays (median pair, IQR 2.19-2.75, 259 NFP days). **FOMC days:** 12:00 Calgary 3.48x, press conference 12:30 2.77x vs a normal day.
- **Era check:** last 2 years vs whole history: median rho 0.95 (forex), 0.99 (stocks); 17.7% of pairs and 19.3% of stocks shifted.
- Stocks in short: strongest half-hours 07:30 (2.06x), 13:30 (1.95x) Calgary (details in Market_Hours_Stocks.md).
summary_stocks: - **Weekdays, stocks:** day activity Mon 0.98x / Tue 1.00x / Wed 1.01x / Thu 1.02x / Fri 0.99x - only 4% between the busiest and the quietest weekday. Best weekday reliable for 25.3% of instruments (mostly Thu 83, Wed 32, Mon 9).

- **All 518 stocks:** strongest half-hours 07:30 (2.06x), 13:30 (1.95x) Calgary. The 07:30 open: volume 1.62x, range 2.63x, big-move days 75.3%. The 13:30 last half-hour: volume 3.63x but range 1.05x.
- **Each stock's own best half-hour:** 07:30 for 307 stocks, 13:30 for 211 stocks; best times reliable for 96.3% of stocks.
- **NFP Fridays:** opening half-hour range 1.08x other Fridays (median stock); **FOMC days** 12:30 Calgary 1.94x.
- **Era:** median rho last 2 y vs all 0.99, before vs since 2020 0.99; 19.3% of stocks shifted.
